fields.name: agent_id_norm
fields.description: Fixed unit identity within the same controllable unit type, normalized to (0, 1].

fields.name: group_slot_norm
fields.description: Slot index of this unit inside the active task group, normalized to (0, 1]; 0 when unassigned.

fields.name: hp_norm
fields.description: Own current HP divided by maximum HP.

fields.name: damaged
fields.description: 1 when alive below maximum HP.

fields.name: fire_cooldown_remaining_norm
fields.description: Remaining time before this unit may fire, divided by 300 seconds.

fields.name: combat_lock_remaining_norm
fields.description: Remaining forced stationary time, divided by 300 seconds.

fields.name: nearest_blue_ground_hp_norm
fields.description: Current HP ratio of the nearest locally detected compatible ground target.

fields.name: task_assigned
fields.description: 1 while this unit belongs to an active ground task.

fields.name: is_stationary
fields.description: 1 when actual unit speed is at or below 1 m/s.

fields.name: speed_norm
fields.description: Actual unit speed normalized by max_speed_mps.

fields.name: heading_sin
fields.description: Sine of the unit's actual heading reported by AFSIM.

fields.name: heading_cos
fields.description: Cosine of the unit's actual heading reported by AFSIM.

fields.name: last_action_id_norm
fields.description: Last ground action id divided by the largest configured ground action id.

fields.name: target_slot_1_exists
fields.description: 1 when this compatible ground target slot is occupied.

fields.name: target_slot_1_known
fields.description: 1 when this fixed target is currently detected by red ground forces.

fields.name: target_slot_1_distance_norm
fields.description: Distance to this target normalized by max_distance_m.

fields.name: target_slot_1_bearing_sin
fields.description: Sine of bearing to this target.

fields.name: target_slot_1_bearing_cos
fields.description: Cosine of bearing to this target.

fields.name: target_slot_1_hp_norm
fields.description: Current HP ratio of this target.

fields.name: target_slot_1_is_ground_force
fields.description: 1 when this target is an enemy ground-force unit.

fields.name: target_slot_1_is_radar
fields.description: 1 when this target is an enemy radar facility.

fields.name: target_slot_1_is_sam
fields.description: 1 when this target is an enemy SAM facility.

fields.name: target_slot_1_in_weapon_range
fields.description: 1 when this target is inside ground_weapon_range_m.
